items.agency: City of Albuquerque Sustainability Office / U.S. Environmental Protection Agency
items.title: Albuquerque Metropolitan Statistical Area Priority Climate Action Plan
items.description: Presents the 2024 EPA Climate Pollution Reduction Grants Priority Climate Action Plan for the Albuquerque MSA, identifying near-term measures across buildings, renewable energy, transportation, waste, and neighborhoods with regional greenhouse-gas, equity, delivery-agency, and benefits analyses.
items.provenance_status: authoritative government EPA CPRG repository for a City of Albuquerque-led regional plan; local staged copy byte-identical to the official EPA PDF
processing_notes: EPA official copy and user-supplied staged original are byte-identical: 4,632,373 bytes; SHA-256 230e94dad7e3ad51001febf18a041640fe8a6f5b04ce99aca93e51896cd39634.
Distinct regional 2024 PCAP that builds on, but does not replace, the 2021 City Climate Action Plan and 2023 Central New Mexico inventory.
